download_vlcs_dataset: download the VLCS domain generalization dataset to a specified data directory
download_pacs_dataset: download the PACS domain generalization dataset to a specified data directory
download_domain_net_dataset: download the DomainNET multi-source dataset with six domains to a specified data directory
download_terra_incognita_dataset: download the Terra Incognita camera trap dataset and organize images by location and category
download_and_extract_archive: download a file from a URL and extract tar.gz, tar, or zip archives automatically
